title: Customer-driven quantization tweak runbook and validation for FP8 exemption
creator: Priya Shah
description: Customer FinServCo reported quality regressions when switching their latency-critical fraud model to the platform FP8 profile. They requested a temporary FP8 exception and a bespoke calibration run that preserves their latency SLA while restoring model accuracy within an agreed tolerance. This ticket coordinates the support-driven calibration run, captures the runbook, validation thresholds, rollback criteria, and artifacts for audit and future automations.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration run produces <0.8% top-line accuracy delta on the customer acceptance set compared to baseline INT8 reference
95th percentile token latency remains <= 1.2x baseline; no P99 regression beyond the SLA window
Automated eval harness (A/B) shows no more than 1% increase in high-confidence false positives on fraud class
Run artifacts (calibration profile, quant params) uploaded to S3 and referenced in Confluence; clear rollback tag available
calibration_plan: Stage 1: Reproduce customer regression locally using customer's seed dataset (striped sampling of 5k transactions) and baseline model redwood/gptx-fraud-8B:v2026-01
Stage 2: Run FP8 calibration with stratified per-layer clipping using calib-tool v0.9.3; record per-layer scale/zero points to s3://redwood-quant/ENG-61347/
Stage 3: Run targeted mixed-precision profile (FP8 for attention + INT8 for matmuls) and compare token-wise logits to INT8 baseline using KS and mean-absolute-diff
Stage 4: Execute end-to-end customer acceptance A/B test in dedicated sandbox (dedicated-pool-07) with traffic shadowing; collect telemetry and error cases
Stage 5: If criteria met, produce release candidate profile and coordinate with Customer Success for gradual rollout (canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100%)
Fallback: If any metric exceeds thresholds, tag v1.24-quant-fp8-exempt-rollback and revert to INT8 profile for that customer's dedicated pool
validation_results: Local reproduction succeeded: observed 1.6% accuracy delta on initial FP8 profile (worse than target)
After per-layer clipping and bias-correction, delta reduced to 0.55% on the 5k acceptance set
Latency: median token latency unchanged; 95th percentile increased 1.15x which is within the 1.2x threshold
False positive rate on fraud class increased 0.6% — within the 1% allowed slack
decisions: Approve bespoke FP8 profile (calib-v2) for FinServCo on dedicated pool with staged rollout
Require additional hidden validation set (10k samples) to be run in parallel during canary to monitor drift
Automate per-layer clipping heuristics in next sprint (owner: infra/quant) to reduce manual iteration
